description: This file is a unit test class for testing the BuzzDao data access object within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It contains test cases for retrieving, saving, and deleting buzz posts, shares, photos, videos, and comments, ensuring the correct behavior of BuzzDao methods.

classes.name: BuzzDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzDao functionalities such as CRUD operations on posts, shares, comments, photos, videos, and related data in the OrangeHRM Buzz system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment with fixture data before each test method runs.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Tests retrieval of buzz feed posts with specific filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total buzz feed posts based on filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Tests retrieving photo IDs associated with a specific post ID.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPost
methods.description: Tests saving a new BuzzPost entity and verifies the stored data.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzShare entity linked to a BuzzPost, verifying persistence.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLink (video link) associated with a BuzzPost.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Tests saving BuzzPhoto entities, including reading image files and verifying storage.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost1
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost and verification that related shares are also removed.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost2
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost with associated shares and photos.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost3
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost with associated shares, photos, and links.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzShare by ID and verifies cascade deletion.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare2
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzShare with specific linkage and verifies related entities.

methods.name: testGetBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare for a given post ID and verifies its type.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList1
methods.description: Retrieves list of shares for a specific post ID and verifies contents.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList2
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving shares for a post with no reshares.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount1
methods.description: Counts shares for a specific post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount2
methods.description: Counts shares for a post with no reshares and expects zero.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific comment by its ID and share ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzComments
methods.description: Tests retrieving comments linked to a specific share ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Verifies counting comments for a specific share ID.
